expert_proposals.title: Reverse statistics-target direction: lower default_statistics_target 300->150
expert_proposals.configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=300 was raised from 100 across r005/r006/r009/r010/r013; the r013 300->500 step was refuted (GetUserTweets p50 +6.9%, p95 +5.7%, TPS -6.5%). The monotone-upward statistics direction is falsified, so the justified move is the opposite direction with equal-or-larger safe amplitude.
expert_proposals.mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates 87.6% of terminal capacity at p50=138us with an Index Scan plan already observed. Raising statistics resolution to 300/500 did not shorten the index path and instead regressed TPS, consistent with ANALYZE/planning overhead and MCV bloat on a skewed user_id without selectivity benefit. Lowering default_statistics_target to 150 halves histogram/MCV build cost and planner estimate work while retaining 1.5x the original 100 resolution, testing whether the incumbent's high target is a net cost.
expert_proposals.query_effect: GetUserTweets remains on its observed Index Scan path; planner estimate cost per call drops slightly, and ANALYZE cycles on the tweets/user tables complete faster, reducing background CPU contention with the 5 terminals.
expert_proposals.expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps by >=0.3% relative to incumbent 32428.77 rps.
expert_proposals.expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets p50 and p95 by >=1% relative; no tail regression expected.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Lower from incumbent 300 to 150, inside allowed [50,500]; 1.5x the original 100 resolution, a larger safe downward amplitude than the refuted 300->500 upward step.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed user_id selectivity; lower target cuts histogram/MCV build and planner estimate cost

predictions.rationale: Lower statistics target reduces per-call planning/estimate overhead on the dominant transaction; reverses the refuted upward direction.
Same mechanism at the p95 leaf; r013 showed p95 rose 5.7% when target went up, so the reverse should recover.
Freed terminal capacity from shorter GetUserTweets raises completed-transaction goodput.

alternatives.statement: default_statistics_target is not on the critical path; GetUserTweets latency is bound by index page access, so 300->150 leaves p50/p95 and TPS unchanged within noise.
The real lever is planner cost calibration, not statistics resolution; a random_page_cost/seq_page_cost move would change the GetUserTweets path while statistics target stays inert.

cross_domain_requirements: If statistics target is inert, memory_storage WAL commit-path and concurrency_maintenance predicate-lock bundles remain the competing mechanisms for the 87.6% terminal-capacity transaction.

expert_proposals.title: WAL commit-path bundle: disable commit_delay, gate siblings high, engage writer flush batching
expert_proposals.configuration_cause: commit_delay=100us with commit_siblings=2 applies a fixed sleep to nearly every commit (only 5 terminals), adding per-commit stall without coalescing real groups; wal_writer_flush_after=0 disables writer-side flush batching so WAL writes are not coalesced.
expert_proposals.mechanism: The incumbent pays a fixed 100us group-commit sleep on almost every commit because commit_siblings=2 is trivially satisfied by 5 terminals, yet wal_writer_flush_after=0 prevents the WAL writer from batching writes. Setting commit_delay=0 removes the unconditional stall; raising commit_siblings to 20 keeps the (zero) window inactive so no accidental sleep returns; setting wal_writer_flush_after=256 (2MB) lets the WAL writer coalesce background writes, reducing wal_waiting_backends and InsertTweet commit latency without gating foreground commits.
expert_proposals.query_effect: InsertTweet commit path loses the fixed 100us sleep and benefits from coalesced WAL writer flushes; GetUserTweets read path unchanged.
expert_proposals.expected_tps_effect: Modest increase in successful transaction TPS as InsertTweet terminal occupancy drops and commit queueing eases.
expert_proposals.expected_latency_effect: InsertTweet p95 decreases; overall p95 roughly unchanged since GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe low bound 0 (allowed [0,1000]); removes the fixed per-commit sleep that is active on nearly every commit with 5 terminals.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: group-commit collection window; 0 disables the fixed sleep

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Safe high bound 20 (allowed [0,20]); with 5 terminals, 20 siblings guarantees the (zero) window never activates, preventing accidental stall.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: group-commit activation threshold; high value keeps window inactive

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Set from 0 to 256 (8kB units = 2MB) within safe [0,1024]; engages writer-side flush batching so background WAL writes coalesce instead of flushing per write.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: writer flush batch size; batches background WAL writes

predictions.rationale: Removing the fixed 100us commit sleep and enabling writer flush batching should cut InsertTweet commit latency.
Writer-side flush batching should reduce backends waiting on WAL.
Freed InsertTweet terminal capacity raises completed transaction goodput.

alternatives.statement: wal_waiting_backends p95=1 is sampling noise and the commit path is not the binding constraint; TPS stays flat.
Larger wal_writer_flush_after delays durability batching and increases InsertTweet tail latency instead of reducing it.

cross_domain_requirements: query_execution: GetUserTweets dominates 87.6% terminal capacity; read-path latency is the primary TPS lever and is untouched here.

expert_proposals.title: Restore default predicate-lock granularity caps to cut SIRead promotion churn
expert_proposals.configuration_cause: Incumbent sets max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0, forcing the coarsest SIRead granularity on every GetUserTweets scan; r012 showed the opposite extreme (2/-2) was refuted, so the true optimum lies between the extremes and the incumbent's 0/0 extreme is untested against a midpoint.
expert_proposals.mechanism: SERIALIZABLE GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.876) with zero lock waits and zero retries, so predicate-lock bookkeeping cost, not conflict, is the lever. With max_pred_locks_per_page=0 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=0 every scan immediately promotes to relation-level SIRead locks, maximizing per-transaction lock churn and locks_total. r012 tested the opposite extreme (2/-2) and was refuted, indicating the response is non-monotonic. Setting page=1 and relation=1 keeps promotion near the coarse end but avoids the degenerate zero-cap path, testing a distinct interior point on the same granularity axis with a new scalar prediction on locks_total.p95.
expert_proposals.query_effect: GetUserTweets index scans retain page-level SIRead locks slightly longer before relation-level promotion, reducing per-transaction lock bookkeeping without introducing lock waits.
expert_proposals.expected_tps_effect: Small increase (0.3-1%) if lock bookkeeping is a measurable share of GetUserTweets terminal time; unchanged otherwise.
expert_proposals.expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 flat to slightly lower; no change to p50.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Interior point between incumbent 0 and refuted r012 value 2, within allowed [0,256]; 1 avoids the degenerate zero-cap path while staying near the coarse end.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: page-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 1 retains page-level SIRead locks one step longer than 0 before promotion

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Interior point between incumbent 0 and refuted r012 value -2, within allowed [-2,4096]; positive cap of 1 relation-level lock avoids the zero-cap degenerate path.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: relation-level predicate-lock granularity cap; 1 caps relation-level SIRead locks at one before promotion

predictions.rationale: Interior granularity caps (1/1) avoid the degenerate zero-cap promotion path that maximizes relation-level SIRead churn at 0/0.
Lower lock bookkeeping per dominant transaction trims tail latency.
Freed terminal capacity from GetUserTweets converts to completed-transaction goodput.
No conflict regime observed (retry ratio 0, lock waits 0); granularity change must not create waits.

alternatives.statement: If the incumbent 0/0 extreme is already optimal, locks_total.p95 will not fall and TPS will be flat or slightly lower, indicating the granularity axis is exhausted and effort should shift to the WAL commit path.
If promotion churn is budget-bound rather than cap-bound, raising max_pred_locks_per_transaction 8192->16384 would lower locks_total.p95 while cap changes do not.

expert_proposals.why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent sits at the untested degenerate extreme (0/0) of the predicate-lock granularity axis; r012 refuted the opposite extreme (2/-2). An interior point (1/1) is the only remaining untested region and can only help if bookkeeping is the cost driver, with no conflict risk given zero lock waits and zero retries.

nodes.label: Interior SIRead granularity avoids degenerate zero-cap promotion churn
